package domain

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestNormalizeStudentLearningWorkspaceRequiresFrozenAtomicShape(t *testing.T) {
	workspace := testLearningWorkspace()
	normalized, err := NormalizeStudentLearningWorkspace(workspace)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, workspace, normalized)

	for _, mutate := range []func(*StudentLearningWorkspace){
		func(value *StudentLearningWorkspace) { value.Schema = "student-learning-workspace.v2" },
		func(value *StudentLearningWorkspace) { value.ContextVersion = 0 },
		func(value *StudentLearningWorkspace) { value.SelectedPath.Status = "PAUSED" },
		func(value *StudentLearningWorkspace) { value.SelectedPath.Items = []StudentLearningWorkspaceItem{} },
		func(value *StudentLearningWorkspace) { value.SelectedPath.Items[0].Position = 1 },
		func(value *StudentLearningWorkspace) { value.SelectedPath.Items[0].Status = "UNKNOWN" },
		func(value *StudentLearningWorkspace) {
			value.SelectedPath.Items = append(value.SelectedPath.Items, value.SelectedPath.Items[0])
		},
	} {
		candidate := testLearningWorkspace()
		mutate(&candidate)
		_, err := NormalizeStudentLearningWorkspace(candidate)
		require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace)
	}
}

func TestStudentLearningWorkspaceDigestIsStableAndStateSensitive(t *testing.T) {
	workspace := testLearningWorkspace()
	first, err := StudentLearningWorkspaceDigest(workspace)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	second, err := StudentLearningWorkspaceDigest(workspace)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, first, second)
	require.Regexp(t, `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`, first)

	workspace.ContextVersion++
	changed, err := StudentLearningWorkspaceDigest(workspace)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotEqual(t, first, changed)
}

func testLearningWorkspace() StudentLearningWorkspace {
	return StudentLearningWorkspace{
		Schema: StudentLearningWorkspaceSchemaVersion, ContextVersion: 3,
		SelectedPath: &StudentLearningWorkspaceSelectedPath{
			LearningPathID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
			CourseID:       "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			Status:         "ACTIVE", PathVersion: 4,
			Items: []StudentLearningWorkspaceItem{{
				ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
				Position: 0, Status: LearningWorkspaceItemReady,
			}},
		},
	}
}
